g.text: RoatheRank3Convo2 begins.

g.title: j384646712
g.text: How were you planning on overthrowing the Executors?

g.title: j242691715
g.text: [End.]

g.title: j3720655375
g.text: Check boolean RoatheKnowsReset2

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j193543716
g.text: Why ask me this? What are you attempting to learn, Drifter? You are not asking after the location of munitions, certainly.

g.title: j3720655375->j193543716
g.text: true

g.title: j3102303055
g.text: Why? Planning on going back in time and beating your younger self's record? In need of advice on how to overthrow a totalitarian government? Seeking the location of buried munitions that could detonate whole planets?

g.title: j3720655375->j3102303055
g.text: false

g.title: j2644265086
g.text: Why would I trust you? Why did I trust you?!

g.title: j2976081616
g.text: Or are you merely making idle conversation?

g.title: j2310817378
g.text: Check boolean RoatheResetForgiven

g.title: j130409742
g.text: I'm curious to know if you regret any of it, honestly. If you'd go back and change any of what you planned.

g.title: j635264071
g.text: I'm fascinated by the idea of what it would have been like to try to come up with a plan like that. It must have been a masterpiece.

g.title: j2565284186
g.text: It might honestly be good to know, if you hid any of those weapons anywhere that are still accessible.

g.title: j2825966902
g.text: I have forgiven you for doing the deed. I simply wish I remembered why - why! Why you, of all people?!

g.title: j2310817378->j2825966902
g.text: true

g.title: j2600496109
g.text: Why! Why you, of all people?!

g.title: j2310817378->j2600496109
g.text: false

g.title: j1857507879
g.text: Add 1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j942292438
g.text: Add -1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j1481815392
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j461029194
g.text: I know. And I'm still so sorry.

g.title: j82208263
g.text: I'm trying to get you to a place where you know why.

g.title: j3038526430
g.text: I'm still sorry I broke your trust, Roathe. I wasn't trying to, believe it or not.

g.title: j3231804031
g.text: All I regret is that it never came to fruition. I regret the wasted time.

g.title: j260639257
g.text: And a masterpiece it was, Usurper.

g.title: j1819013527
g.text: Practical. But so many of the places where I "hid" my supplies have likely... wandered in the many, many years that have passed.

g.title: j707276627
g.text: Yes, yes. I suppose we should carry on with this silly conversation where we retread our previous conversations once more.

g.title: j3692867731
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j883738937
g.text: Yes, you likely believed there would not be consequences to your actions. But regardless, we should carry on with this silly conversation where we retread our previous selves and simply get on with it.

g.title: j557199888
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1383196879
g.text: And many of the locations were secret even to me. The plan was beyond intricate. Layers upon layers upon layers deep.

g.title: j4273091872
g.text: What was your question again? Ah! Yes. "How was I planning on overthrowing the Executors?"

g.title: j551854925
g.text: By retreading the same pointless conversations about why I wanted to murder people who are long since dead and dust? At least it is the pragmatic approach.

g.title: j591375069
g.text: The plan was beyond intricate. Layers upon layers upon layers deep. Assassins who would kill the assassins of other assassins should the first assassin fail.

g.title: j3940573709
g.text: Assassins who would kill the assassins of other assassins should the first assassin fail.

g.title: j2103972086
g.text: Why?

g.title: j4106361757
g.text: Bombs laid in multiple buildings, whole ships and an entire moon rigged to detonate with stolen explosives. A solar rail ready to fall out of orbit.

g.title: j2786102933
g.text: And all of it rigged to look like a "Great Sentient Disaster" when the time came. Nitokh and I would declare the Empire in a state of emergency once the Executors and Emperors were... dealt with.

g.title: j1742364006
g.text: Boolean RoatheTraitor2 is now true.

g.title: j285070892
g.text: Check boolean RoatheExecutor1

g.title: j2826466175
g.text: What if your plan didn't work?

g.title: j285070892->j2826466175
g.text: true

g.title: j285070892->j2826466175
g.text: false

g.title: j4287794810
g.text: And what were you going to do then?

g.title: j285070892->j4287794810
g.text: true

g.title: j285070892->j4287794810
g.text: false

g.title: j3778486626
g.text: What did you plan to do about Nitokh?

g.title: j285070892->j3778486626
g.text: true

g.title: j4252123173
g.text: It was one of the many thousands of possible outcomes for which I had a plan.

g.title: j27678670
g.text: There were a thousand possible outcomes to what we had planned. For each variable in play, a possible variant of a path was created.

g.title: j1932713100
g.text: Check boolean RoatheKnowsReset2

g.title: j3262867769
g.text: If we failed spectacularly, I would have simply eaten the end of a Lex and called it a day.

g.title: j2031741063
g.text: And for each one, I had laid out a result. And for each one, I knew what I intended to do. Many were similar in the broad strokes of things, but were dissimilar in the details.

g.title: j3913872040
g.text: What have I told you before about it? Because I find I do not yet trust you enough to tell you outright.

g.title: j1932713100->j3913872040
g.text: true

g.title: j3045781125
g.text: It was a complex matter of some... great negotiation between us.

g.title: j1932713100->j3045781125
g.text: false

g.title: j1963963479
g.text: No point crying over spilled Kuva, and all that.

g.title: j2530596794
g.text: If we failed spectacularly, I would have simply eaten the end of a Lex and called it a day.

g.title: j4028338776
g.text: You told me everything.

g.title: j483783294
g.text: Then I won't push you to tell me more than you want to.

g.title: j317642642
g.text: There is a lot buried in that sentence.

g.title: j3942734803
g.text: What kind of negotiations?

g.title: j2186808807
g.text: I would have run, personally.

g.title: j3163494170
g.text: You would have just accepted death?

g.title: j2038292945
g.text: If it was a middling success, which was the most likely, cleanup would be required to ensure all loose strings were "dealt with." Naturally, of course, I was one of those strings. And I had steps to ensure that I was still too valuable in the short term to be snipped with the rest.

g.title: j3532973893
g.text: Then there is no point in my repeating myself now, is there? Indeed, there is hardly a point to this conversation at all. Have a lovely rest of your day.

g.title: j1804564980
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1626836581
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j142424655
g.text: Every kind you can imagine.

g.title: j3096574606
g.text: And run to where, my Usurper? Not all of us have pocket dimensions to escape to when we are in a panic.

g.title: j185361033
g.text: I would have had little other choice, would I? Nowhere to go, nowhere to hide.

g.title: j325274172
g.text: If the situation was a rousing success, I would have gone forward with phase two of the plan.

g.title: j1118431560
g.text: Good. I shall say that it was a complex matter of some... great negotiation between us.

g.title: j3133689937
g.text: Centuries beneath the sands.

g.title: j1861383400
g.text: Boolean RoatheExecutor2 is now true.

g.title: j3925565425
g.text: Nitokh had made it painfully clear that if we failed, I would be the public sacrifice.

g.title: j1328725929
g.text: What was phase two?

g.title: j3124536553
g.text: Killing Nitokh?

g.title: j1717274806
g.text: Evaluate expressions on HellStory counter

g.title: j1417435782
g.text: And were you okay with that?

g.title: j876837005
g.text: Not a terribly good idea to threaten you, if she wanted your loyalty.

g.title: j2490891556
g.text: Murdering Nitokh, of course. Hardly a surprising twist. She knew herself it was likely to happen, and taunted me with it quite regularly.

g.title: j596495675
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3283268355
g.text: As you know, I was one of her many her many playthings.

g.title: j1110742369
g.text: I was one of her many partners, you understand.

g.title: j1717274806->j1110742369
g.text: false

g.title: j686873236
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3557903600
g.text: One thing you must understand about Orokin is that we were always scheming against each other.

g.title: j2980506922
g.text: And she was okay with that?

g.title: j2920472592
g.text: You both just knew you were out to kill each other?

g.title: j1275536292
g.text: Check boolean RoatheKnowsReset2

g.title: j1443707305
g.text: I once believed us to be partners. In politics, in intrigue, in bed...

g.title: j3241492245
g.text: Business partners?

g.title: j3054567803
g.text: Partners, how?

g.title: j83580213
g.text: Hardly. But one thing you must understand about Orokin is that we were always scheming against each other.

g.title: j1753074051
g.text: I knew that Nitokh would kill me without hesitation at any point if it might even possibly aid her in the pursuit of her goals.

g.title: j1387101207
g.text: I think she enjoyed the challenge, Usurper. The sense of danger. The thrill of knowing she was sleeping with someone who wanted her dead.

g.title: j1318899630
g.text: I would like to pretend that we were the first Orokin to find themselves in such a situation, but it was not even that uncommon.

g.title: j2335820028
g.text: Precisely! It is almost as though you have heard this before. But it is hardly a surprising twist. She taunted me with it quite regularly.

g.title: j1275536292->j2335820028
g.text: true

g.title: j2440794059
g.text: Precisely! But it is hardly a surprising twist. She saw it coming as well, and taunted me with it quite regularly.

g.title: j1275536292->j2440794059
g.text: false

g.title: j754657845
g.text: I did not believe us to be equals, of course. She was an Executor. The Great Nitokh. But I thought myself First Amongst Her Lessers.

g.title: j165939203
g.text: You are adorable. Yes, in a manner of speaking, we were business partners. But we were also partners in many other more important ways.

g.title: j2754578162
g.text: In war. In politics. In intrigue. In bed.

g.title: j3788689673
g.text: Yet she knew that I was sharpening my knives behind her back and eagerly awaiting the moment where I would remove her head from her shoulders.

g.title: j358882354
g.text: The longer I live the more I realize we may not have been a species designed for immortality.

g.title: j1661704123
g.text: What I fool I was...

g.title: j3122135702
g.text: But I wonder if I am misremembering. I wonder if "partner" is too strong a word for what we really were.

g.title: j3300929295
g.text: You could say we had a... complex relationship.

g.title: j371153959
g.text: But, yes. You could say that Nitokh and I had a... complex relationship.

g.title: j3884238298
g.text: Did you care about her?

g.title: j2614320978
g.text: Did you love her?

g.title: j2859879059
g.text: Did you trust her?

g.title: j16964959
g.text: Don't regret what you did. You made your choices. There's no going back. Only forward.

g.title: j3771074441
g.text: The only thing we can do is make up for what we've done before is to look ahead with clear eyes.

g.title: j3961314499
g.text: She was the Great Nitokh after all. An Executor.

g.title: j1445399367
g.text: Void, no! If she drunkenly wandered out an airlock one afternoon it would have solved a great deal of my damnable problems.

g.title: j2866352138
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2892560846
g.text: Void, no! Never trust an Orokin, Drifter. Including me. Especially me! Love us, hate us, adore us, despise us - but never, ever trust us.

g.title: j250137640
g.text: Add -1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j1032206747
g.text: Add 1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j675628185
g.text: I absolutely, positively despised her, and I would have adored nothing more than to slowly, carefully, gently peel her blue skin off her body with my bare hands.

g.title: j2797839429
g.text: What an impertinent question! I think I adore you for asking it. You know, I think I did love her, just a little. I have honestly not even stopped to ponder that until right this moment.

g.title: j681172887
g.text: We are prone to fits of restlessness.

g.title: j3122888601
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j1608528489
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j1509160783
g.text: That was... vivid.

g.title: j1360098821
g.text: And yet you were sleeping with her?

g.title: j3661193462
g.text: Yes, I think I was just the slightest bit infatuated with her. What a curious realization...

g.title: j9883457
g.text: Noted.

g.title: j4269034065
g.text: That wasn't going to be a problem.

g.title: j2319794396
g.text: You may be right. Living in the past is dangerous, for we saddle ourselves with regret and shame and nothing else.

g.title: j1670363753
g.text: You may be right. Living in the past is dangerous, for we saddle ourselves with regret and shame and nothing else.

g.title: j445280444
g.text: Picturing it in my mind was the only thing that allowed me to suffer through many of my... mandatory evenings in her bed. I apologize.

g.title: j2031327618
g.text: The fact that you believe those two things are mutually exclusive is positively adorable. I hope you have the opportunity to experience an evening with such an "acquaintance" someday, it is fairly magical.

g.title: j3912174263
g.text: You must understand, it was also clouded over with the deepest and most extremely overwhelming hatred as well. I despised her in the same breath and I would have adored nothing more than to slowly, carefully, gently peel her blue skin off her body with my bare hands.

g.title: j3607220764
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j2532285862
g.text: Mm, yes. I get the sense I am not precisely winning you over with my "devilish charm," am I?

g.title: j4007514014
g.text: What point is there, reliving our past deeds, our past failures and regrets? We cannot change them - even with this gift of time travel, it is only a path to madness to attempt to "redo" that which has been "done."

g.title: j2589115935
g.text: But neither can we forget the misdeeds of our former selves, for we risk becoming nothing but madmen and despots, belligerent creatures who see no fault within ourselves and only within others.

g.title: j1119696217
g.text: Do you have those thoughts about all your lovers? or just her?

g.title: j4234944871
g.text: No apology necessary. I'm just still shocked at how much you hated your own people.

g.title: j1016852798
g.text: I simply recommend that you do not make such relationships a permanent affair. It becomes wildly unhealthy for both parties. It usually ends in murder for one or both of you.

g.title: j1679949405
g.text: How can both of those things be true at the same time?

g.title: j76792568
g.text: That was... vivid.

g.title: j1193193359
g.text: I simply thought I should give you the fair warning, seeing as we have our little... arrangement.

g.title: j3607220764->j1193193359
g.text: RoatheDatingDeal

g.title: j2309760109
g.text: Mm, although, it will never be a problem with you, will it? You have your eye set far closer to home with Marie in our little "arrangement."

g.title: j3607220764->j2309760109
g.text: RoatheMarieDatingDeal

g.title: j2236860836
g.text: Mm, although, it will never be a problem with you, will it? You have your eye set far closer to home with that mad priest, don't you?

g.title: j3607220764->j2236860836
g.text: RoatheLyonDatingDeal

g.title: j3607220764->j2236860836
g.text: DrifterLyon

g.title: j2272640744
g.text: I simply thought I should give you the fair warning, seeing as you have made your... interests known.

g.title: j3607220764->j2272640744
g.text: DrifterRoathe

g.title: j708150103
g.text: Mm, although, it will never be a problem with you, will it? You have your eye set far closer to home with Marie, don't you?

g.title: j3607220764->j708150103
g.text: DrifterMarie

g.title: j2673220837
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3607220764->j2673220837
g.text: false

g.title: j2256930578
g.text: No. Sorry. You aren't my type.

g.title: j2538347332
g.text: You are. I just don't trust you.

g.title: j1281490655
g.text: No. I am what I am. I am who I am. I walk the path I have chosen and I am past the point of wishing to apologize for myself. I will not change what I am to suit the opinions of others.

g.title: j3092222697
g.text: This was a trait I saw in many of the poorest of the Executors and the Emperors - blind faith in only their own faultless and guiltless selves. I despised them for it and vowed I would never share such egotistical hubris.

g.title: j1579246975
g.text: I only ever truly dabbled with partners of the physical sense, Drifter. I never had emotional ones. None that were ever mutual, at any rate.

g.title: j2880511743
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1912445034
g.text: I'll take that to heart.

g.title: j3149290966
g.text: I wasn't planning on it, but thank you for the advice.

g.title: j3583235115
g.text: The fact that you have never experienced such a thing makes you exceedingly lucky, Usurper. I do not recommend finding yourself in such an arrangement, it usually ends in murder for one or both of you.

g.title: j3856600688
g.text: Picturing it in my mind was the only thing that allowed me to sit through many a long meeting. I apologize.

g.title: j3350787485
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j245585342
g.text: She is quite beautiful, I cannot say that I blame you. Though I do not think I could withstand the self-righteous piety, personally.

g.title: j2774561346
g.text: He is handsome enough. But he looks as though if a flower wilts he might declare it is the end of it all and throw himself from the nearest tower.

g.title: j1127631878
g.text: It does have me wondering which one of us has caught your eye, if any.

g.title: j705993254
g.text: Your loss, but you do have quite the array of options to choose from, don't you? I am certain you will find someone to... amuse yourself with.

g.title: j4137689758
g.text: Check boolean IsDating

g.title: j737812691
g.text: Thank you for reminding me.

g.title: j1281467825
g.text: You've never been in love?

g.title: j3812884184
g.text: What do you mean?

g.title: j2319234134
g.text: I did not hate all of them. Only some of them. The ones in power. And that was why it was so terribly doomed in the end.

g.title: j3637661270
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2109802677
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2312291555
g.text: Do you have those thoughts about all your lovers? or just her?

g.title: j2000532938
g.text: I never thought about Orokin board meetings, until right now.

g.title: j717782162
g.text: How lovely to know that all sense of good taste and class has not fled this system after all.

g.title: j1108854839
g.text: But! Suit yourself. Let me know if I can be of any assistance. I am deeply entertained by the notion of watching you and the zealot embroil yourself in all sorts of needless emotional entanglements.

g.title: j2681580443
g.text: Check boolean IsDating

g.title: j2400958161
g.text: Mm. Wise. Although that does beg the question, have I happened to catch your eye, Drifter? If you think it concerns me that you are wrapped up with another, it does not.

g.title: j4137689758->j2400958161
g.text: true

g.title: j3384839978
g.text: Mm. Wise. Although that does beg the question, have I happened to catch your eye, Drifter?

g.title: j4137689758->j3384839978
g.text: false

g.title: j1062205185
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2623017213
g.text: Must I spell it out for you? Very well. I have never been in love.

g.title: j3435653199
g.text: For all of our advances, for all the work we did to save humanity - we never solved the greatest issue that plagued us in our hearts. The greatest flaw that ate at our souls like a atrous cancer.

g.title: j3948078203
g.text: See that you do. You seem like you are doing your best to live a good life, Drifter. To be a "good" person. I would hate to see you wind up like the Orokin. We were defined by our excess.

g.title: j2319195863
g.text: Quite welcome. You seem like you are doing your best to live a good life, Drifter. To be a "good" person. I would hate to see you wind up like the Orokin. We were defined by our excess.

g.title: j1569114633
g.text: I only ever truly dabbled with partners of the physical sense, Drifter. I never had emotional ones. None that were ever mutual, at any rate.

g.title: j3595008363
g.text: Pathetic, isn't it? All the advances in the universe and we still could not manage to figure out how to organize ourselves without wasting hours of everyone's lives gathered around a table talking past each other.

g.title: j3580156730
g.text: Well, now that we know which target you have aimed your bow at, that gives us something to work toward, doesn't it?

g.title: j1785742954
g.text: I don't think I'd trust you with that.

g.title: j1762583291
g.text: Really? You'd... help?

g.title: j3182825895
g.text: You do seem to have an inclination towards "protoframes," after all.

g.title: j2681580443->j3182825895
g.text: true

g.title: j2350810108
g.text: Or do you not have an inclination toward "protoframes?"

g.title: j2681580443->j2350810108
g.text: false

g.title: j2488742414
g.text: And before you start typing up a furious rebuttal and angrily denounce my person for encouraging any sort of unfaithfulness on your part, give me one moment to explain.

g.title: j3355871056
g.text: It's Lyon.

g.title: j1505712452
g.text: It's Marie.

g.title: j1586989001
g.text: [Confess feelings.] ...Yes..

g.title: j3716797281
g.text: No.

g.title: j4232798911
g.text: It's none of your business.

g.title: j3448765824
g.text: How sad is that? I know. No, I have not been. Never mutually.

g.title: j3078864355
g.text: Has it ever been a one-sided affair? Oh, most certainly. But that is not a romance, is it? That is a tragedy.

g.title: j903803884
g.text: Bureaucracy.

g.title: j3514673004
g.text: It is an existence that tends to come to define you by its loneliness.

g.title: j3504143281
g.text: You don't seem surprised.

g.title: j2316261006
g.text: I wasn't sure how you were going to react.

g.title: j1449330365
g.text: Probably wise. Mundane, but wise.

g.title: j2785239593
g.text: Of course! Best case, you distract one of them from their seemingly intractable goal of harassing me.

g.title: j4226215900
g.text: I'm already with someone, though. Wouldn't that be a problem for you? Or Marie and Lyon?

g.title: j3394660368
g.text: I'm already in a relationship.

g.title: j982740931
g.text: I do. Just none of you are "it."

g.title: j1040877556
g.text: I do. My heart belongs to someone already, but these things take time.

g.title: j612313117
g.text: When one lives for as long as we do, one comes to understand that some hearts can hold affection for many more than one.

g.title: j591616775
g.text: Boolean DrifterLyon is now true.

g.title: j1668414876
g.text: Boolean DrifterMarie is now true.

g.title: j2447315236
g.text: Boolean DrifterRoathe is now true.

g.title: j2179852534
g.text: How you wound me.

g.title: j909206261
g.text: Boolean DrifterUnknown is now true.

g.title: j3953449992
g.text: You think me a devil now? My reputation has only improved in this far-flung future, my Usurper.

g.title: j2519343239
g.text: Nothing in the world stagnates human greatness quite like the adherence to systems and paperwork at all costs.

g.title: j3100182879
g.text: Do you think you are the first person I have ever come across who wants to "dance with the devil of Tau?" Hardly. It simply remains to be seen how genuine your interest is, or if it is merely over after you spend a night or two scratching your itch.

g.title: j1718382584
g.text: I suppose I will just have to sit back and watch it all fall apart on its own. Or, you succeed and one of them becomes too distracted from their seemingly intractable cause of harassing me.

g.title: j1297254277
g.text: Worst case, it all ends terribly and I am provided with hours of free entertainment.

g.title: j3920786039
g.text: You might be surprised. We Orokin were notorious for multiple partners, yes, but it was merely for the physical affection.

g.title: j1413802314
g.text: Do you love them? And it it mutual?

g.title: j1855944206
g.text: Oh? And which one of us have caught your fancy? Or is it someone else, some"when" else?

g.title: j199766114
g.text: It is just simply another way of being, for those who experience life in such a fashion.

g.title: j4105924146
g.text: What? Why?! Do you really have so little respect for yourself? Or do you have a penchant for collecting sad, miserable things?

g.title: j3025989767
g.text: Why am I not surprised? With that thing...bobbing in your field of view all the time, it is hardly any wonder. A miracle anyone around here gets any work done.

g.title: j849119085
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1274574569
g.text: The pain.

g.title: j2668584669
g.text: Fair enough. But that is neither a "no" nor a "yes" so I shall leave this box neither checked nor stricken out, but circled.

g.title: j2431972347
g.text: Wrap your mind around that and you might understand why few wished to linger at my side.

g.title: j635696621
g.text: Bah. But we have wandered far off topic. A conversation for another day. I must go for now.

g.title: j3526630542
g.text: A bridge we will cross when we come to it.

g.title: j3873612015
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1079241752
g.text: When one lives for as long as we do, one comes to understand that some hearts can hold affection for many more than one.

g.title: j1547810992
g.text: No.

g.title: j557892986
g.text: I don't know. Maybe.

g.title: j3372274392
g.text: I do. And I hope it is.

g.title: j3163194098
g.text: It's none of your business.

g.title: j3107052670
g.text: It's someone you wouldn't know.

g.title: j3142456503
g.text: It's none of your business.

g.title: j3676687015
g.text: I am simply stating that if you were to have feelings in your heart for more than one individual at a time, that I would not fault you for it, that is all.

g.title: j389037855
g.text: He is handsome enough, I suppose. But he looks as though if a flower wilts he might declare it is the end of it all and throw himself from the nearest tower.

g.title: j1435971245
g.text: Well, I wish you all the best of luck. I couldn't stand her self-righteous and never-ceasing piety. Then again, she views me as nothing but a reprobate.

g.title: j2693291827
g.text: Mm, isn't this just utterly delicious...?

g.title: j2405102427
g.text: The agony.

g.title: j2897226119
g.text: An intriguing response.

g.title: j779926630
g.text: Boolean RoatheUnloved1 is now true.

g.title: j4081414586
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3499784640
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3875590964
g.text: Either way, I win.

g.title: j3221159600
g.text: It is just simply another way of being, for those who experience life in such a fashion.

g.title: j2351771126
g.text: Just an idle fancy, then? Ah, what it means to be alive. Enjoy it while you can, I say.

g.title: j3449939623
g.text: Follow where your heart may lead you, Drifter. If there is one thing I might regret in all my years, I believe it is the fact that I never shared it with another.

g.title: j137303313
g.text: Good.

g.title: j3359542299
g.text: I was not prying for the sake of simple gossip, I merely wished to give you a piece of advice. (Though I do adore me some gossip, mind.)

g.title: j174760133
g.text: Boolean DrifterUnknown is now true.

g.title: j3084592352
g.text: Boolean DrifterUnknown is now true.

g.title: j4247876654
g.text: Thanks. I guess.

g.title: j2127191315
g.text: But! Suit yourself. Let me know if I can be of any assistance. I am deeply entertained by the notion of watching you and the zealot embroil yourself in all sorts of needless emotional entanglements.

g.title: j2270541057
g.text: And not in the endearing way, either.

g.title: j76676711
g.text: How lovely to know that all sense of good taste and class has not fled this system after all.

g.title: j4266888058
g.text: Horrors.

g.title: j1700296991
g.text: In the meanwhile, I am flattered by the compliment, intrigued by the prospect, and look forward to the continued... hunt.

g.title: j1935598725
g.text: I suppose I would only have one piece of advice for you.

g.title: j1829556750
g.text: I don't need to take dating advice from an Orokin. Or any advice from from an Orokin.

g.title: j3987031125
g.text: Thanks.

g.title: j2943053946
g.text: You've never been in love?

g.title: j929480637
g.text: Fair enough. I merely wished to give you a piece of advice.

g.title: j3472663857
g.text: You are welcome. "I guess."

g.title: j2024184986
g.text: Well, now that we know which target you have aimed your bow at, that gives us something to work toward, doesn't it?

g.title: j2442346802
g.text: Horrors, I say.

g.title: j3032033183
g.text: Suit yourself.

g.title: j4240590216
g.text: Don't mention it.

g.title: j1551570545
g.text: Never mutually.

g.title: j3499280033
g.text: Boolean RoatheInsulted is now true.

g.title: j1933300832
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j3854304096
g.text: Has it ever been a one-sided affair? Oh, most certainly. But that is not a romance, is it? That is a tragedy.

g.title: j937572522
g.text: You think me a devil now? My reputation has only improved in this far-flung future, my Usurper.

g.title: j3733028093
g.text: Wrap your mind around that and you might understand why few wished to linger at my side.

g.title: j1601796036
g.text: +10 Chemistry
